identification: Pro Hart (Kevin Charles Hart, 1928-2006), small hand-coloured line etching from the Waltzing Matilda series (swagman in red shirt hiding behind a gum, jumbuck drinking at the billabong), plate signed and dated 'PRO HART 77' lower centre, plate approx 127 x 147 mm, Lytlewode Press restrike, unsigned publisher's/printer's proof. Framed in black with white mat. With a Robert C. Littlewood (Lytlewode Press) certificate dated 15 Dec 2011.
